description: Canonical registry for the phased calculator and blog branding rollout. scripts/branding/check-registry.ts enforces the rules and scripts/branding/generate-counter.ts writes the rollout sections of pagepushed-counter.md from this file. IDs are permanent: never renumber, never recycle a RETIRED id.

exemptRoutes.reason: Redirect alias to /calculators (HTTP 307); no page of its own.

batches.note: One-off bulk batch: every page still PENDING moved to PageNav and SiteFooter together, at the owner's request, instead of ten calculators and ten blogs a day. Size and contiguity rules do not apply to a bulk batch; every other rule does.
